name: Kaze no Kuni no Oujo-sama -Dai Ni Shou-
original_name: 風の国の王女様-第二章-
source:
The Princess of the Land of the Wind - Chapter 2 is the visual novel of the Amazoness Queen of Sei*en Densetsu 3 who is brutalized in her sleep by a brute beast.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038874.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《风之国的公主 - 第2章》是一部视觉小说，讲述了《圣园传说3》中的亚马逊女王在睡梦中被野兽残害的故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038874.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
